name: sophia-items-to-paste.xlsx
purpose: Chapter 6 (6.07): a block of quote lines the tester copies in Excel / Numbers / Google Sheets and pastes into Sophia’s Items table. Chapter 7 (7.10) reuses it as “Your quote” in Upload two quotes.
content:
One sheet, 9 rows × 8 columns, starting at A1, header row first, numbers as plain numbers (no S$, no formulas). Tab-separated:
Item	Description	Qty	Unit	Cost	Unit Price	Category	Room
Hacking of kitchen floor and wall tiles	Hack and cart away existing tiles	1	Lot	1400	1800	Hacking	Kitchen
Waterproofing to bathroom floors	3-coat membrane with upturn	2	Lot	260	350	Masonry	Bathrooms
Homogeneous floor tiles, supply and lay	600 × 600 mm, kitchen and yard	140	sqft	8	11	Masonry	Kitchen
Kitchen top and bottom cabinets	Laminate finish, soft-closing hinges	22	ft run	190	250	Carpentry	Kitchen
Quartz countertop	With sink and hob cut-outs	11	ft run	120	170	Carpentry	Kitchen
Full-height wardrobe	Swing doors, master bedroom	10	ft run	240	330	Carpentry	Master Bedroom
Lighting points	New points with wiring	16	point	45	65	Electrical	Whole unit
Painting, whole unit	Nippon Vinilex, two coats	1	Lot	1300	1800	Painting	Whole unit

(Unit Price minus Cost becomes the markup. The 8 lines total S$17,550.00 at Unit Price. Keep the column names exactly — the paste window reads them to pick each column’s field.)

name: kitchen-moodboard.jpg
purpose: Chapter 6 (6.22) the file attached to Sophia’s quote; 6.41 and chapter 7 (7.10) use it as a file the readers must refuse (a photo that is not a quote).
content: Any real JPG photo of a kitchen or a mood board, about 1200×800, under 2 MB. Its content is never read; do NOT put “flo”, “dyel”, “cove”, “stanley”, “sharon” or “sales contract” in the file name.

Trade	Item	Qty	Unit	Rate	Amount
